title: The Marina at Brentwood Bay Resort
specs: Calm waters of Brentwood Bay and Saanich Inlet ideal for boating, paddling, scuba diving
Access to adults-only luxury resort amenities including heated pool and hot tub
Primary renter must be at least 21 years old
Primary operator must have a driver's license, credit card, and proof of competency in their own name
Canadian and U.S. renters must have boating license if mandatory in their province/state
Boats seat up to 4 adults or 2 adults and 3 children
includes: Garmin GPS & chart plotter with waypoints
gap: Exact cancellation policy details not stated
blurb: Guests can rent small boats to explore Brentwood Bay and Saanich Inlet from April through October. The marina offers on-dock facilities and access to resort amenities including a heated pool and hot tub. The area is known for calm waters ideal for boating, paddling, and scuba diving.
extraNote: $500 security deposit required · Reservations can be made up to 5 days in advance, weather permitting · Alcohol is not allowed on rental boats · No fishing, crabbing, prawning or towing from rental boats · Marina open year-round; occasional short closures in winter for maintenance · The Marina at Brentwood Bay Resort, 849 Verdier Avenue, Victoria, BC · Open year-round; small boat rentals available April through October, weather permitting
